rows.text: General Notice 1392 of 1999 (Office of the Presidency) notifies that the President, in accordance with sections 91(2) and 93 of the 1996 Constitution, decided '(a) to appoint Mr J. G. Zuma as Deputy President with effect from 17 June 1999', and to appoint listed Ministers with effect from the same day.
